blockers: Every placement comes from one community table (the VPW Film Crew's v1.1) and none was checked against the manual's location drawings, so all of them stay observed. Promotion needs a callout check of the drawings or a second, independent table lineage.

No matrix lamp has a coordinate. The table drives lamps 1-63 through bulb-mode light-map source Lights that draw no bulb and models no insert bulb, and a light that sits on no bulb makes no socket; the lamps need a reproducible measurement on the manual's Lamp Locations drawing (printed page 31). Lamps 31, 40 and 43 have no bound Light at all: each lights two inserts, the script fades two light-map sets for each with live Lampz.Callback lines and leaves only its Lampz.MassAssign line commented out, and choosing between the table's Lights would rest on their names alone. Which address the right captive-ball insert is wired to is a recorded conflict.

Flash lamps 2R-6R and 8R (26-30, 32) have no coordinate: the table drives them through light-map sources at playfield height and models no bulb or dome, and a raised flash-lamp socket is never placed on a light-map source. Their sockets are drawn on the manual's Flash Lamp / Coil Tests location drawing.
Flash drive 9 has no coordinate: two of its lamps ride the crane boom and two light the backbox insert.
The G.I. relay 11 has no coordinate: the table's G.I. Lights are light-map sources that draw no bulb, and no retained page counts or locates the G.I. bulbs.
The crane lock 4 rides the sweeping boom and has no fixed location; the knocker 8 is located by no retained page.
CN3 pins 5-1 (solenoid addresses 40-44) have no coordinate: no retained page shows anything connected to them.
The crane motor 14 is a projection onto the crane's rotation axis, and the drop-target reset coil 13 a projection onto the middle drop target.

The crane limit switches 60 and 61 have no coordinate: the table binds no object to them, and the manual's Switch Locations drawing (printed page 29) prints them at the two ends of the boom's sweep, 60 at the left ramp entrance and 61 at the top of the right orbit beside 47, not at the crane's axis.
The three magnets 37-39 are placed on the table's magnet triggers; the manual says only that they are in the centre of the playfield.

coordinate_origins.object_centers: every other placement uses its retained object's own stored center (Light, Kicker, Bumper, Spinner) or position (HitTarget)

excluded_object_classes: Baked lightmap primitives (*_LM_*) faded by Lampz.Callback: they paint light, and are never sockets.
Light-map source Lights bound to flash lamps (f2-f6) and the G.I. Lights gi001-gi025: they sit at playfield height and draw no bulb, so they are not raised sockets.
Cabinet and topper primitives (PinCab_*), VR backglass sprites and Lights the script never binds, such as f7, f8, L31, L31B, L40, L40B, L43 and L43B.
The manual's switch, lamp and flash-lamp location drawings: read and transcribed, but not used for any coordinate.

extraction.manifest_algorithm: Canonical JSON containing format/version and every extracted file as sorted relative POSIX path, byte size, and SHA-256.

projections.reason: The drop-target reset coil is projected onto the middle drop target sw19; the retained table models no coil.
The crane motor is projected onto the crane's rotation axis, which the Crane Assembly drawing puts the motor under; it is not a measured motor centre.

four No. 89 flash lamps, two in the crane cab and two on the backbox insert panel (the manual's '(2) CRANE (2) INSERT'): the crane cab lamps are raised on the sweeping boom, the insert lamps are backbox, and the script binds no playfield Light to Lampz index 109 (its MassAssign(109) = f9 is commented out; only lightmaps, a VR backglass sprite set and no Light follow it)

crane left limit: the script binds no object to it (the timer-driven CraneIsLeft just sets Controller.Switch(60)), and the manual's Switch Locations drawing (printed page 29) prints 60 at the left end of the boom's sweep, at the left ramp entrance beside the left lock, not at the crane's rotation axis; the table models no limit switch there, so the switch has no coordinate until a callout measurement on that drawing places it

crane right limit: the script binds no object to it (CraneIsRight just sets Controller.Switch(61)), and the Switch Locations drawing prints 61 at the right end of the boom's sweep, at the top of the right orbit beside the VUK 47; the table has a baked mesh CraneSwitch_BM_Room near that callout, but nothing in the script ties it to 61 and its function is not established, so placing the switch on it would rest on its name alone
